profile.subtitleJa: ペカヒヤを襲った側の一人として名が挙がる。
profile.summaryJa: ペカはサマリアでペカヒヤを襲ったとき、アルゴブとアリエを伴っていました。本文はアルゴブの家族や役職を記していません。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.
